---
pagetitle: "Publications | FraLab"
toc: false
listing:
  - id: articles
    contents:
      - "publications/*.qmd"
      - "publications/preprints/*.qmd"
    template: ./ejs/article.ejs
    categories: false
    sort:
      - "year desc"
    sort-ui: [year]
    filter-ui: [title]
    page-size: 80
    field-display-names: 
      publication: "Publication"
      year: "Year"
---

:::{#articles}
:::

```{=html}
  </div>
  <aside class="pubs-sidebar">
    <div class="pubs-sidebar-title">Types</div>
    <div id="pub-type-filters" class="pubs-type-filters"></div>
    <div class="pubs-sidebar-title">Years</div>
    <ul id="pub-year-list" class="pubs-year-list"></ul>
  </aside>
</div>

<script>
  (function () {
    let activeYear = null;
    function typesetMath() {
      if (window.MathJax && typeof window.MathJax.typesetPromise === 'function') {
        window.MathJax.typesetPromise();
      }
    }

    function decodeTitleHtml() {
      const titles = document.querySelectorAll('#listing-articles .listing-title');
      titles.forEach((el) => {
        const html = el.innerHTML;
        const formulaToHtml = (formula) => {
          let plain = formula
            .replace(/\\mathrm\{([^}]+)\}/g, '$1')
            .replace(/\\mathbf\{([^}]+)\}/g, '$1')
            .replace(/\s+/g, '');
          plain = plain
            .replace(/_\{?(\d+)\}?/g, '<sub>$1</sub>')
            .replace(/\^\{?(\d+)\}?/g, '<sup>$1</sup>')
            .replace(/([A-Za-z])([0-9]+)/g, '$1<sub>$2</sub>');
          return plain;
        };
        let decoded = html
          .replace(/&lt;(\/?)sub&gt;/gi, '<$1sub>')
          .replace(/&lt;(\/?)sup&gt;/gi, '<$1sup>')
          .replace(/\s*<sub>\s*/gi, '<sub>')
          .replace(/\s*<\/sub>\s*/gi, '</sub>')
          .replace(/\s*<sup>\s*/gi, '<sup>')
          .replace(/\s*<\/sup>\s*/gi, '</sup>')
          .replace(/\$([^$]+)\$/g, (_m, inner) => formulaToHtml(inner))
          .replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ');
        if (decoded !== html) {
          el.innerHTML = decoded.trim();
        }
      });
    }

    function buildYearSidebar() {
      const listing = window['quarto-listings'] && window['quarto-listings']['listing-articles'];
      const listRoot = document.querySelector('#listing-articles .pub-list');
      const yearList = document.getElementById('pub-year-list');
      const typeFilters = document.getElementById('pub-type-filters');
      if (!listing || !listRoot || !yearList) return false;

      const items = listing.items.map((item) => item.elm).filter(Boolean);
      const yearCounts = new Map();
      const typeCounts = new Map();

      function selectedTypes() {
        if (!typeFilters) return [];
        return Array.from(typeFilters.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'))
          .filter((cb) => cb.checked)
          .map((cb) => cb.value);
      }

      items.forEach((item) => {
        const typeSpan = item.querySelector('.listing-type');
        const type = typeSpan ? typeSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
        if (type) {
          typeCounts.set(type, (typeCounts.get(type) || 0) + 1);
        }
      });

      const selected = selectedTypes();
      const typeFilteredItems = selected.length
        ? items.filter((item) => {
            const typeSpan = item.querySelector('.listing-type');
            const type = typeSpan ? typeSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
            return selected.includes(type);
          })
        : [];

      typeFilteredItems.forEach((item) => {
        const yearSpan = item.querySelector('.listing-year');
        if (!yearSpan) return;
        const match = yearSpan.textContent.match(/\d{4}/);
        if (!match) return;
        const year = match[0];
        yearCounts.set(year, (yearCounts.get(year) || 0) + 1);
      });

      const years = Array.from(yearCounts.keys()).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
      yearList.innerHTML = '';

      function setActive(linkEl) {
        yearList.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((a) => a.classList.remove('active'));
        if (linkEl) linkEl.classList.add('active');
      }

      function applyFilter(year) {
        if (typeof year !== 'undefined') {
          activeYear = year;
        }
        const types = selectedTypes();
        if (types.length === 0) {
          listing.filter(() => false);
          return;
        }
        listing.filter((item) => {
          const yearSpan = item.elm ? item.elm.querySelector('.listing-year') : null;
          const match = yearSpan ? yearSpan.textContent.match(/\d{4}/) : null;
          const itemYear = match ? match[0] : null;
          const typeSpan = item.elm ? item.elm.querySelector('.listing-type') : null;
          const itemType = typeSpan ? typeSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
          const typeOk = types.length === 0 || types.includes(itemType);
          return (!activeYear || itemYear === activeYear) && typeOk;
        });
      }

      if (typeFilters && typeFilters.childElementCount === 0) {
        typeFilters.innerHTML = '';
        const types = Array.from(typeCounts.keys()).sort();

        types.forEach((type) => {
          const id = `type-${type.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '-')}`;
          const wrap = document.createElement('div');
          wrap.className = 'pubs-type-option';
          const cb = document.createElement('input');
          cb.type = 'checkbox';
          cb.id = id;
          cb.value = type;
          cb.checked = type === 'journal-article';
          cb.addEventListener('change', () => {
            buildYearSidebar();
            applyFilter(activeYear);
          });
          const label = document.createElement('label');
          label.setAttribute('for', id);
          label.textContent = `${type} (${typeCounts.get(type)})`;
          wrap.appendChild(cb);
          wrap.appendChild(label);
          typeFilters.appendChild(wrap);
        });
      }

      const allItem = document.createElement('li');
      const allLink = document.createElement('a');
      allLink.href = '#';
      allLink.textContent = `All (${typeFilteredItems.length})`;
      allLink.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActive(allLink);
        activeYear = null;
        applyFilter(activeYear);
      });
      allItem.appendChild(allLink);
      yearList.appendChild(allItem);

      years.forEach((year) => {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = '#';
        a.textContent = `${year} (${yearCounts.get(year)})`;
        a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setActive(a);
          applyFilter(year);
        });
        li.appendChild(a);
        yearList.appendChild(li);
      });

      if (activeYear) {
        const activeLink = Array.from(yearList.querySelectorAll('a'))
          .find((a) => a.textContent.startsWith(activeYear));
        setActive(activeLink || allLink);
      } else {
        setActive(allLink);
      }
      applyFilter(activeYear);
      decodeTitleHtml();
      typesetMath();
      return true;
    }

    function initWhenReady() {
      if (!buildYearSidebar()) {
        setTimeout(initWhenReady, 250);
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initWhenReady);
    } else {
      initWhenReady();
    }

    if (window['quarto-listing-loaded']) {
      const prev = window['quarto-listing-loaded'];
      window['quarto-listing-loaded'] = function () {
        prev();
        initWhenReady();
      };
    }
  })();
</script>
```
